headline: 9 killed, 25 injured in head-on bus collision in Sylhet
summary: A Unique Paribahan bus and a Bengal Paribahan bus collided in Osmaninagar, leaving several dead and many injured.
details: At least 9 people were killed and 25 others injured in a head-on collision between two passenger buses in Sylhet’s Osmaninagar on Friday morning.
The accident occurred around 7:00 am in the Kashikapon area of the Dhaka-Sylhet highway.
According to Osmaninagar Police, a Unique Paribahan bus and a Bengal Paribahan bus were involved in the crash, which killed seven people on the spot.
The injured were rushed to Sylhet MAG Osmani Medical College Hospital, where one more person died, bringing the total death toll to 9 according to local reports.
Police are currently working to identify the victims of the collision.

headline_marked: 7 killed as [[speeding bus ploughs into workers]] in Bogura
headline: 7 killed as speeding bus ploughs into workers in Bogura
summary: A Dhaka-bound bus lost control near Erulia Bazar, killing seven roadside labourers and injuring 15 others.
details: At least seven people were killed and 15 others injured after a speeding bus lost control and ran over roadside workers in Bogura Sadar upazila this morning.
The accident occurred around 5:30 am near Erulia Bazar on the Bogura-Naogaon highway. A Dhaka-bound Shah Fateh Ali Paribahan bus was attempting to let a motorcycle pass when the driver lost control.
The driver hit the brakes, causing the bus to strike an electric pole, spin around, and run over labourers who were awaiting hire by the roadside. Three people died on the spot.
Fire Service units, transport staff, and locals rescued 18 injured people and rushed them to Shaheed Ziaur Rahman Medical College Hospital.
Three more victims died on the way to the hospital, and one died during treatment, according to hospital police.

Following the tragedy, locals blocked the highway demanding the installation of speed breakers to prevent future accidents. The Roads and Highways Department has since assured that speed breakers will be installed today.
